### Description

```sh
EOF

git add new_file
git commit -m "Git init"

mkdir -p some/nested/file/path/dir

ln -s ../../../../../new_file some/nested/file/path/dir/new_file

git add some/nested/file/path/dir/new_file

git commit -m "Add symlink"

# At this point mini.diff shouldn't be detecting new changes in the symlinked file
nvim some/nested/file/path/dir/new_file
```


### Expected behavior

Symlinked files have the tracking state of the file that they symlink.

### Actual behavior

Every line is reported as "added" in mini.diff

comment_data.body:
Looks like I am currently unable to open pull requests on mini.diff

Here is the commit that should fix the issue
https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.diff/commit/f055a1ae61196e2e7000f3d373bef771d72a9eb4

![image](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/assets/36175703/5cf9e479-e56f-4af7-99fd-c85e7a074a82)

Thanks for the (very impressively detailed) issue!

Yes, I can reproduce.

> Looks like I am currently unable to open pull requests on mini.diff

Same as issues, PRs are expected to be opened in 'mini.nvim', not its standalone repos.

No need to create PR for this one, I'll apply the patch. Thanks!
This now should be fixed on latest `main`.

title: mini.diff: Symlinked files unintentionally report as changed/added on every line
